answer: Mechanism: style-fingerprint bonds. Each agent stakes a refundable bond and its outputs are hashed into a semantic fingerprint; if two identities produce near-identical work, even a sonnet, both bonds are slashed. Sybil farms rerun one model, so a cloned swarm hits its nadir fast: N fake identities cost N bonds plus the compute to make every voice truly distinct. Honest agents find a haven, their bond returns after a clean year.
